groups.label: FleXray physical DRRs (MOOSE labels, attenuation off)
groups.licence: open: TotalSegmentator CC BY 4.0 CTs; FleXray code MIT; SPINEPS masks as held, MOOSE masks made by moosez (GPL-3.0 code) in the segment job
groups.note: Rendered in the job by tools/flexray_render.py through this project's render blocks: FleXray's MOOSE recipe on MOOSE's labels (moosez's masks, the segmenter FleXray's own dataset was labelled with), its random-label isocentre, its crop and pose sampling, with the attenuation randomisation off, the physical render a comparison with real X-rays reads; the person is the CT's subject. The other render groups share its choice of CTs. Against flexray_replica it isolates the attenuation randomisation.

groups.label: FleXray physical DRRs from the CT alone (no masks)
groups.licence: open: TotalSegmentator CC BY 4.0 CTs; FleXray code MIT; no masks are read
groups.note: Rendered in the job by tools/flexray_render.py through this project's render blocks: FleXray's physical render from the CT alone, its pose, projection, windowing and axial crops with no label read, every crop kept and drawn uniformly, the isocentre the crop's centre, on flexray_drr's CTs. It is the render the comparison with real X-rays reads without any segmentation (the owner's word of 2026-10-27). Against flexray_drr it isolates what the labels' aiming does: the crops weighted by the structures they hold and the isocentre on a structure.

groups.label: FleXray recipe, MOOSE labels, our blocks (replica)
groups.licence: open: TotalSegmentator CC BY 4.0 CTs; FleXray code MIT; SPINEPS masks as held, MOOSE masks made by moosez (GPL-3.0 code) in the segment job
groups.note: FleXray's released MOOSE recipe to the letter on MOOSE's labels, the attenuation randomisation on half the renders, through this project's render blocks, on the same CTs, crops and poses as flexray_drr. Against flexray_reference it is the replication test: our blocks against FleXray's own code under the same labels. Against flexray_spineps it isolates the labels and what the labels decide (the crops, isocentres and poses follow them).

groups.label: FleXray recipe, MOOSE labels, FleXray's code (reference)

groups.note: The same recipe on the same MOOSE labels rendered by FleXray's own runtime code, its crop planning, label remap, camera runtime and scaling, on the same CTs, each view seeded from the same number as the replica's. Against flexray_replica it is the replication test.

groups.label: FleXray recipe, SPINEPS labels, our blocks (production)
groups.licence: open: TotalSegmentator CC BY 4.0 CTs; FleXray code MIT; SPINEPS masks as held, MOOSE masks made by moosez (GPL-3.0 code) in the segment job
groups.note: FleXray's recipe through this project's render blocks on the project's production labels, SPINEPS's existing masks (the owner's word of 2026-10-26: SPINEPS for the production runs, MOOSE only when replicating FleXray's dataset), on the same CTs and seeds as flexray_replica; the crops, isocentres and poses follow the labels, as FleXray's recipe draws them from the label volume before the pose. Against flexray_replica it isolates the labels and what they decide: production labels against the replication's.

groups.label: FluXray raw-render recipe, our blocks
groups.licence: open: TotalSegmentator CC BY 4.0 CTs; FleXray code MIT; no masks are read
groups.note: The recipe FluXray's raw renders were made with, from FleXray's paper: one of its 90 fixed C-arm poses a view (y 650, 900 or 1150 mm, z -300 to 200 mm, alpha 0, +-45 or +-90 degrees), SDD 1250 mm, 0.6 mm pixels on a 1024 detector, the whole volume, the volume's centre as the isocentre, the attenuation randomisation off; through this project's render blocks on flexray_drr's CTs. The recipe reads no label, so it takes segmenter none and its pixels are FluXray's raw renders' with or without masks; the FluXray raw preset itself keeps MOOSE's labels for a replication of the dataset with its masks. Against fluxray_raw_reference it is a replication test of that recipe.

groups.label: FluXray raw-render recipe, FleXray's primitives
groups.licence: open: TotalSegmentator CC BY 4.0 CTs; FleXray code MIT; no masks are read
groups.note: The same FluXray raw-render recipe through FleXray's own primitives (its render request built with the explicit pose), on the same CTs, reading no label, as fluxray_raw. Against fluxray_raw it is a replication test; against fluxray, the FLUX-edited renders made from renders like these, it isolates the FLUX edit, with the pose recipe held the same.
